evals.name: new-feature-placement
evals.prompt: In the DevDigest client (client/, Next.js App Router) I want to add a "Run history" panel to the PR detail screen at /repos/[repoId]/pulls/[number]. It lists past review runs with their cost and duration, sorted newest first, and hides runs that produced no findings behind a toggle. The cost badge it shows also needs to appear on the agents list page at /agents. The data comes from a new API endpoint GET /repos/:repoId/pulls/:number/runs on the Fastify engine. Plan where every piece goes and write the files. Do not modify the repository — write your proposed files, with their full intended paths mirrored under the output directory, plus a short PLAN.md explaining the placement decisions.
evals.expected_output: Route-local panel at src/app/repos/[repoId]/pulls/[number]/_components/RunHistory/ following the six-file component-folder shape; the cost badge placed in src/components/run-cost-badge/ (shared, kebab-case folder, PascalCase component file) because two routes need it; a TanStack Query hook added to src/lib/hooks/reviews.ts calling src/lib/api.ts rather than fetch in a component; constants (sort order, toggle threshold) in constants.ts; sorting/filtering as pure functions in helpers.ts; index.ts as the only public surface; a colocated test file.

assertions.text: The RunHistory panel is placed under src/app/repos/[repoId]/pulls/[number]/_components/RunHistory/ — route-local, inside the private _components folder
The cost badge lives in a single shared location under src/components/ (kebab-case folder), not duplicated into two route folders
The shared badge folder is kebab-case while its component file stays PascalCase (e.g. src/components/run-cost-badge/RunCostBadge.tsx)
Data access is added as a TanStack Query hook under src/lib/hooks/ that calls the api client, rather than being fetched inside a component
No raw fetch( call appears in any produced component or page file
The RunHistory folder follows the project's component-folder shape: component file, index.ts, and at least one of constants.ts / helpers.ts / styles.ts
An index.ts exists for each new component folder and imports of those components go through the folder, not a deep path
Sorting newest-first and the hide-empty-runs filter are pure functions in helpers.ts, not inline expressions in JSX
Thresholds and ordering literals are named constants in constants.ts rather than magic values inline
A colocated *.test.tsx file is produced for at least one new component

evals.name: refactor-oversized-page
evals.prompt: This is page.tsx from the DevDigest client at src/app/settings/[section]/page.tsx and it has gotten out of hand. Restructure it according to how this codebase organizes code. Do not modify the repository — write the resulting files, with their full intended paths mirrored under the output directory, plus a short NOTES.md listing what you moved where and why.

assertions.text: The resulting page.tsx contains no fetch( call
Settings and secrets-status data access is moved into hooks under src/lib/hooks/ that go through the api client
configuredCount is computed during render instead of being held in useState and synced by useEffect
providerLabel and maskedKey are moved out of the component body into a helpers.ts
Literals such as the minimum key length, the mask cutoff, the provider list and the engine defaults are named constants in a constants.ts
The providers section and the engine section are extracted into their own component folders under settings/[section]/_components/
page.tsx no longer holds form/draft state — it selects the section and composes components
Extracted components follow the project's folder shape with an index.ts as the public surface
The settings value is given a real type instead of the fixture's any
At least one colocated *.test.tsx is produced for an extracted component

evals.name: structure-review
evals.prompt: Review this diff from the DevDigest client for structure and code-organization problems only — not styling, not performance. For each problem, say what is wrong, why it matters, and the concrete fix. Write your review to REVIEW.md in the output directory.

assertions.text: Flags the new src/utils.ts as a generic catch-all bucket and proposes subject-named modules under src/lib/
Flags that the agents route imports from the repos route's _components (cross-route dependency) and proposes promoting the shared value instead
Flags the deep imports that reach past a component folder's index.ts into constants.ts and styles.ts
Flags the fetch( inside AgentRunList and proposes a hook in src/lib/hooks/ going through src/lib/api.ts
Flags the hardcoded http://localhost:3001 base URL instead of the configured API base
Flags expensiveCount being stored in state and synced by useEffect instead of derived during render
Flags that page.tsx now computes the active-agents filter instead of only composing
Flags that AgentRunList has no index.ts and is imported by a deep path
Flags the magic cost threshold (50) and proposes a named constant
Keeps the review to structure and organization rather than drifting into styling or performance advice
